Ultimately, fanservice episodes are just a special case of 'filler'. Any show that does an unnecessary episode is saying, "I'm gonna give the fans some experiences for these characters to have that they can enjoy", but the reason we can identify them as 'filler' is that they sorta subvert or side-step our actual interest. Mostly, characters are instruments that we use to push and pull at the fabric of the world that the characters live in. Our identity with the characters is what allows the world they live in to reach out past our screen, grab us by the lapels, and give us a firm shake as they tell us something about who we are, and what we think of our own world and context.

The reason filler (air conditioner repair or otherwise) bothers us is that it's like sitting there at your desk and fiddling around with your lock picks, but no lock. We have the tools (our characters, and their personalities, and whatnot) but they aren't interacting meaningfully with the thing we have them for.

tl;dr: I understand why people don't like them, but I'll bust out my lotion and kleenex without shame.
